text:
Changing a flat tyre is a basic and essential automotive skill for every Aventro Motor car owner. This guide will walk you through:
- Steps to change a tyre
- Where the spare tyre and toolkit is found in all Aventro models
- General tips and safety instructions
path: Aventro Motors: How to Change a Tyre
doc_key: aventro motors- how to change a tyre

locations.heading: Aventro Motors: How to Change a Tyre
Aventro Motors: How to Change a Tyre

text:
- Model Type: Hatchback | Common Location of Spare Tyre & Toolkit: Under the boot floor in the rear compartment
- Model Type: Sedan | Common Location of Spare Tyre & Toolkit: Under the boot floor in the trunk
- Model Type: SUV | Common Location of Spare Tyre & Toolkit: Under the boot floor or mounted underneath the rear of the car
- Model Type: (All Models) | Common Location of Spare Tyre & Toolkit: Toolkit is usually secured next to the spare tyre or inside a side panel of the boot/trunk
Note: All variants (Petrol/Diesel/Electric/Hybrid) follow the same compartment arrangement.
path: Aventro Motors: How to Change a Tyre > Where to Find the Spare Tyre & Toolkit in Aventro Models
doc_key: aventro motors- how to change a tyre

locations.heading: Where to Find the Spare Tyre & Toolkit in Aventro Models
Where to Find the Spare Tyre & Toolkit in Aventro Models

text:
- Pull over to a safe, flat location away from traffic.
- Turn on your hazard lights.
- Apply the handbrake.
- Place wheel wedges/blocks (if available) to prevent vehicle movement.
path: Aventro Motors: How to Change a Tyre > Steps to Change a Tyre > 1. Park Safely
doc_key: aventro motors- how to change a tyre

text:
You will need:
- Spare tyre (found as per table above)
- Jack (usually in toolkit)
- Lug wrench (in toolkit)
- Wheel wedges/blocks (optional)
- Vehicle owner's manual (for reference)
path: Aventro Motors: How to Change a Tyre > Steps to Change a Tyre > 2. Gather Tools
doc_key: aventro motors- how to change a tyre

text: - If your wheel has a cover, use the flat end of the wrench or the provided lever to gently pry it off.
path: Aventro Motors: How to Change a Tyre > Steps to Change a Tyre > 3. Remove the Wheel Cover/Hubcap
doc_key: aventro motors- how to change a tyre

text:
- Use the lug wrench to turn the lug nuts counter-clockwise.
- Loosen them slightly – do not remove fully at this stage.
path: Aventro Motors: How to Change a Tyre > Steps to Change a Tyre > 4. Loosen the Lug Nuts
doc_key: aventro motors- how to change a tyre

text:
- Position the jack under the jacking point nearest to the flat tyre. Refer to your owner’s manual for the exact point.
- Raise the vehicle until the flat tyre is about 6 inches above the ground.
path: Aventro Motors: How to Change a Tyre > Steps to Change a Tyre > 5. Lift the Vehicle with the Jack
doc_key: aventro motors- how to change a tyre

locations.heading: 5. Lift the Vehicle with the Jack

text:
- Unscrew the lug nuts completely.
- Remove the flat tyre and set it aside.
path: Aventro Motors: How to Change a Tyre > Steps to Change a Tyre > 6. Remove the Lug Nuts and Tyre
doc_key: aventro motors- how to change a tyre

locations.heading: 6. Remove the Lug Nuts and Tyre

text:
- Line up the holes and push the spare onto the hub.
- Replace the lug nuts and tighten them by hand.
path: Aventro Motors: How to Change a Tyre > Steps to Change a Tyre > 7. Mount the Spare Tyre
doc_key: aventro motors- how to change a tyre

text:
- Carefully lower the car with the jack until the tyre touches the ground firmly.
- Remove the jack.
path: Aventro Motors: How to Change a Tyre > Steps to Change a Tyre > 8. Lower the Vehicle
doc_key: aventro motors- how to change a tyre

text: - Use the lug wrench to tighten the lug nuts in a star pattern to ensure even pressure.
path: Aventro Motors: How to Change a Tyre > Steps to Change a Tyre > 9. Tighten the Lug Nuts
doc_key: aventro motors- how to change a tyre

text: - Place the hubcap back onto the wheel.
path: Aventro Motors: How to Change a Tyre > Steps to Change a Tyre > 10. Replace the Hubcap or Wheel Cover (if applicable)
doc_key: aventro motors- how to change a tyre

locations.heading: 10. Replace the Hubcap or Wheel Cover (if applicable)

text:
- Put the flat tyre, jack, and tools back in their compartments.
- Double check everything is secure.
path: Aventro Motors: How to Change a Tyre > Steps to Change a Tyre > 11. Stow Equipment
doc_key: aventro motors- how to change a tyre

text:
- Never change a tyre on a slope or close to traffic.
- Use hazard warning triangle if available.
- After installation, drive slowly and get the spare tyre pressure checked at the nearest Aventro Service Center.
- Some spare tyres are “space savers” and are not intended for long distances or high speeds.
path: Aventro Motors: How to Change a Tyre > Safety & Tips
doc_key: aventro motors- how to change a tyre

text:
Aventro offers Roadside Assistance across India. If you are unable to change the tyre, please contact your nearest:
- Aventro Service Center
- Or call Aventro Roadside Assistance (see main service manual/contact card in your glove box)
